## Auto-fixed

### `how-to/reducing-an-oversized-hedge.html` (generated by nightly script using different template)

6 fixes applied in a single commit:

1. **CSS path corrected:** `/assets/css/main.css` → `../assets/css/styles.css`. The page was completely unstyled on the live site because the referenced file does not exist.
2. **Language attribute:** `lang="en"` → `lang="en-GB"` (SEO, content-language consistency).
3. **Robots meta tag added:** `<meta name="robots" content="index,follow,max-image-preview:large,max-snippet:-1" />` was absent; added to `<head>`.
4. **Phone numbers corrected:** `01304 611150` / `+441304611150` → `07763 100477` / `+447763100477` (2 occurrences; wrong number from nightly template).
5. **Pensioner discount corrected:** `10% pensioner discount` → `5% off for pensioners` (matches site-wide value).
6. **GA4 consent mode added:** Consent default block was missing; added before the GA4 script tag, matching the pattern on all other pages.

## Needs Review

### 1. `how-to/reducing-an-oversized-hedge.html` — wrong HTML template (nav/footer structure)
The nightly script generated this article with a different nav and footer template: different CSS class names (`logo`, `main-nav`, `nav-list`, `has-dropdown`, `footer-inner`, `footer-logo`, `footer-bottom`) that do not exist in `styles.css`. The article body content is now styled correctly after the CSS fix above, but the nav bar and footer will render without the site's standard layout. Requires a rebuild of the header and footer sections to use the standard template classes. **Content decision; do not auto-fix.**

### 2. `how-to/choosing-hedge-species-kent.html` — missing WCA-1981 nesting callout (carry-over)
The article covers timing guidance for species selection in Kent but does not include an explicit reference to the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 nesting window (1 March-31 August). All other timing-related articles carry this callout. Flagged in previous audits (2026-08-25, 2026-08-26). Needs new prose matching house style. **Content decision; report only.**

### 3. YouTube video verification — proxy blocks all requests (recurring)
All `curl -sI` checks against YouTube watch URLs return `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` from the proxy environment. Cannot verify live status of 23 video references across the site this run. This has been recurring since at least 2026-08-23. Videos were referenced from established UK channels (RHS, Garden Ninja, Hopes Grove, Burncoose, STIHL GB, best4hedging, Bunny Guinness, Ashridge Nurseries) whose authority is used as fallback. **Recommend manual spot-check when YouTube access is available.**
